mine_bitexts_search: run the LASER mine_bitexts tool in search mode to find closest target sentences for each source sentence
mine_bitexts_score: run the LASER mine_bitexts tool in score mode to compute alignment scores for paired source and target sentences
mine_bitexts_mine: run the LASER mine_bitexts tool in mine mode to extract parallel bitext pairs from two monolingual corpora
knn_GPU: run GPU-accelerated k-nearest-neighbor search on sentence embeddings using FAISS with inner product similarity
TextLoadUnify: load a text file and optionally deduplicate sentences while preserving original line indices
